If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap late horizon (15–30 days) at 1.5% above recent peak to prevent runaway inflation.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid horizon (8–14 days) to counteract pessimism bias.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is flat, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (15–30 days) to reflect bullish momentum.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–14 days) to prevent momentum overextension.
